ohtani.title: Dave Roberts recaps the Dodgers' 2-1 win over Tigers

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' 19-2 win

okamoto.title: George Springer paces Blue Jays' offense in 8-1 win

murakami.title: Colson Montgomery homers in White Sox 7-4 win

matsui.title: Merrill, Vásquez lead Padres to 3-0 shutout win
